method: Real Python finalizer and adjacent Node CSS validator against complete miniature r9000/r9001 deployment graphs, recursive before/after path/byte/mode/mtime snapshots on failures, valid SRI/build/SW/inventory/ZIP verification and package-only rerun.
limitations: This suite checks release preflight behavior and static dependency scope; it does not execute CSS layout, network requests, offline startup or audio.
Image fixture bytes are a signature-only sentinel because dependency validation checks existence and inventory membership, not image decoding.
